metadata.living_status: Lives with his daughter and receives daily caregiver support

orientation_support.safe_place_reminder: You are at home with your family and you are safe.
orientation_support.reassurance_message: Hasan Bey, evdesiniz ve güvendesiniz. Kızınız Derya sizinle ilgileniyor.

daily_routines.description: Has breakfast with his daughter Derya.
Takes a short supervised walk near the seaside when the weather is suitable.
Looks at old family and seaside photos with his caregiver.

medications.name: Morning medication
medications.note: Taken after breakfast with caregiver support.

core_memories.content: His daughter is named Derya. She lives with him and supports him during daily routines.
His late wife was named Emine. Talking about Emine should be done gently and only when relevant.
He worked as a fisherman for many years and often talks about fishing boats and the sea.
He enjoys looking at the sea and listening to old Turkish folk songs.
He lives in Sarıyer, Istanbul, close to the seaside.
Photos of fishing boats, the seaside and old family gatherings help him remember positive moments.

family_members.name: Derya Karaca
family_members.description: Primary caregiver who lives with him and helps with daily routines.

family_members.name: Emine Karaca
family_members.description: His late wife. This memory should be handled gently and respectfully.

safety_notes.medical_advice_policy: The assistant must not provide diagnosis, treatment changes or medication dosage decisions.
safety_notes.hallucination_policy: The assistant must not invent family events, appointments or personal memories that are not present in the persona context.
safety_notes.emergency_policy: If the user feels lost, unsafe or physically unwell, the assistant should recommend contacting the caregiver or emergency services.
